desc.zh: 按数位周期统计 0 到 n 中每一次数字 1 的出现。
desc.en: Count every digit-one occurrence from 0 to n with place-value cycles.

complexity: O(log n) time; O(1) auxiliary space

concepts.name: place-value cycles
concepts.description: Each decimal position repeats every 10f numbers.

concepts.name: higher/current/lower invariant
concepts.description: The three parts determine the unfinished cycle contribution.
